paper_title: Non Axiomatisability of Positive Relation Algebras with Constants, via Graph Homomorphisms
statement: We have shown that on the signatures SP1, SP> and SP1>, Rel is not finitely axiomatisable with a set of (in)equations. Does this change if we are more flexible on the shape of axioms? For example if Horn sentences or first-order formulas are allowed as axioms? We have given a necessary condition on signatures for Rel to be finitely based. This is the decomposability condition given in Proposition 8. Can we obtain a full characterisation?
